description: Security descriptor for Sria Info Tech AI Finance Dashboard Generator

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.FinanceAnalyst
scopes.description: Read financial dashboards and query approved finance metrics

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.FinanceManager
scopes.description: Create, modify, archive, and share financial dashboards

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.TenantAdmin
scopes.description: Administer workspaces, data source references, and audit logs

role-collections.name: SriaFinanceAnalyst
role-collections.description: View and interact with Sria Finance Dashboards

role-collections.name: SriaFinanceManager
role-collections.description: Create, edit, and share Sria Finance Dashboards

role-collections.name: SriaTenantAdministrator
role-collections.description: Full administrative access to Sria Finance workspaces and connections
